$description: HS-96-01 — HoldSpeak's design-token source of truth. Three layers per the vendored design-system skill: primitive (raw values), semantic (purpose names), component (the modern Desk OS chrome). scripts/generate-tokens.cjs emits src/styles/tokens.css from this file; edit HERE, never the CSS.

2.doc: faint text on light paper (at least 4.5:1)

300.doc: gradient amber head (HS-115-08: forge ember family)

500.doc: forge ember (~3.1:1 on ink.0; system patina, not signal)

650.doc: ember ink (HS-202-05): the accent plate that CARRIES TEXT — 5.24:1 with paper.0, where orange.500 reads 3.79:1

shadow.$doc: black ink alphas for depth (dark theme's shadow ramp)

wash.$doc: ink washes for hairlines and hover fills on light paper

450.doc: the Workbench blue primary and selection

semantic.$doc: Today's canonical Signal names, values preserved verbatim from the hand-written tokens.css (HS-30-03 lineage). Consumers use THESE names.

sound.$doc: HS-135-12 L4: canonical sound names (documentation only — NO --sfx-* CSS properties per counsel ruling A.L4 condition 1). Runtime is sfx.ts with a typed enum; per-sound concurrent pool cap 3; mono 22050Hz 16-bit WAV (OGG preferred); sub-120ms; total well under 100KB.

names.name: key-down
names.character: relay click — a dry snap, one cycle, no ring

names.name: key-up
names.character: solenoid release — slightly softer than key-down

names.name: latch
names.trigger: window open/close, recording started, meeting capture begins
names.character: card latch engaging — a mechanical click with a tiny settle

names.name: land
names.trigger: delivery landed, artifact received, result arrived
names.character: object landing on desk — a soft thud with no bounce

names.name: file
names.trigger: item filed into zone, relationship toggled

names.name: error
names.character: a stuck key — the same relay as key-down but doubled (click-click)
